description: This XML file defines simple-methods for managing survey questions, responses, and validation logic within the OfBiz framework. It includes service definitions for creating and updating survey questions and responses, as well as inline validation methods for response data.

methods.name: createSurveyQuestion
methods.description: Handles creation of a new survey question with validation for specific question types.

methods.name: updateSurveyQuestion
methods.description: Updates an existing survey question, validating question type-specific fields.

methods.name: createSurveyResponse
methods.description: Manages creating a survey response, including validation, duplicate check, and saving answers.

methods.name: validateSurveyResponseInline
methods.description: Performs validation checks on individual responses based on question type (e.g., date, email, credit card).

methods.name: processSurveyResponseInline
methods.description: Prepares and stores individual answer responses within the overall survey response.
